consts.name: dgqChildrenDiceSides
consts.comment: Family structure prose (capture pp. 62-64): the children per space roll 1d8

consts.name: dgqChildrenDiceMod
consts.comment: Family structure prose (capture pp. 62-64): the minus-2 on the children roll - negatives and zero mean no offspring

consts.name: dgqMarriageDiceSides
consts.comment: Marriages prose (capture pp. 62-64): the marriage check die 1d6

consts.name: dgqMarriageRollMax
consts.comment: Marriages prose (capture pp. 62-64): a female member marries on 1-5 on 1d6

consts.name: dgqMarriageBonusPct
consts.comment: Marriages prose (capture pp. 62-64): the +10 percent reaction bonus from marriage-related NPCs

consts.name: dgqAdoptChancePct
consts.comment: Adoptions prose (capture pp. 62-64): the 1-in-20 chance that any person entered the clan by adoption

consts.name: dgqAdoptDiceSides
consts.comment: Adoptions prose (capture pp. 62-64): the orphan check die 1d6

consts.name: dgqAdoptOrphanMax
consts.comment: Adoptions prose (capture pp. 62-64): an adopted member is an orphan on 1-2 on 1d6

consts.name: dgqAdoptBonusPct
consts.comment: Adoptions prose (capture pp. 62-64): the +10 percent reaction bonus with the adopted clan

consts.name: dgqDeathCheckPerYear
consts.comment: Deaths prose (capture pp. 62-64): the fate check once per game year

consts.name: dgqDeathHeadPct
consts.comment: Deaths prose (capture pp. 62-64): the Head of Family row death chance, 10 percent

consts.name: dgqDeathFatherPct
consts.comment: Deaths prose (capture pp. 62-64): the Father row death chance, 7 percent

consts.name: dgqDeathSiblingPct
consts.comment: Deaths prose (capture pp. 62-64): the Siblings row death chance, 5 percent

consts.name: dgqDeathFirstbornPct
consts.comment: Deaths prose (capture pp. 62-64): the possessions pass to the firstborn son 75 percent of the time

bools.name: dgqChartDirectBranchOnly
bools.comment: Family structure prose (capture pp. 62-64): the chart is only needed for the branch leading to the player character

bools.name: dgqLineageDieClosestNotLess
bools.comment: Family structure prose (capture pp. 62-64): the lineage die most closely matches the spaces without being less - five spaces means 1d6

bools.name: dgqLineageRerollOverflow
bools.comment: Family structure prose (capture pp. 62-64): a lineage die roll greater than the spaces means roll again

bools.name: dgqComplicationsOptional
bools.comment: Additional structures prose (capture pp. 62-64): the complications are optional and fleshed out gradually

bools.name: dgqPcFemalesNeverRequired
bools.comment: Marriages prose (capture pp. 62-64): player character females are never required to be married

bools.name: dgqMarriageUsuallyOutsideClan
bools.comment: Marriages prose (capture pp. 62-64): the marriages are usually outside the family clan

bools.name: dgqMarriageEqualRank
bools.comment: Marriages prose (capture pp. 62-64): the marriages are usually between families of approximately equal rank

bools.name: dgqAdoptOrphansRelatedOnlyClan
bools.comment: Adoptions prose (capture pp. 62-64): orphans are related only to the members of their adoptive family clan

bools.name: dgqAdoptTwoClansWhenAlive
bools.comment: Adoptions prose (capture pp. 62-64): an adoption with the hereditary family alive leaves two family clans

bools.name: dgqAdoptOftenPolitical
bools.comment: Adoptions prose (capture pp. 62-64): the adoptions often cross birth ranks and are politically motivated

bools.name: dgqPolygamyLegal
bools.comment: Polygamy prose (capture pp. 62-64): polygamy is legal and not unknown in the OA societies

bools.name: dgqPolygamyMostMonogamous
bools.comment: Polygamy prose (capture pp. 62-64): most marriages are monogamous

bools.name: dgqPolygamyGrandfatherFatherOnly
bools.comment: Polygamy prose (capture pp. 62-64): only a polygamous grandfather or father has any effect

bools.name: dgqFirstWifeChildrenInherit
bools.comment: Polygamy prose (capture pp. 62-64): the first wife is most favored - her children are eligible for direct inheritance

bools.name: dgqInheritanceFirstSonFirstWife
bools.comment: Polygamy prose (capture pp. 62-64): as a rule the inheritance passes to the first son of the first wife

bools.name: dgqFurtherGenerationsNoModifier
bools.comment: Further generations prose (capture pp. 62-64): the ancestors beyond three generations give no reaction modifiers

bools.name: dgqInterrelatedDmApproval
bools.comment: Interrelated prose (capture pp. 62-64): the interrelated player characters need the DM agreement

bools.name: dgqInterrelatedSameRace
bools.comment: Interrelated prose (capture pp. 62-64): the interrelated characters must be of the same race - barbarians only with barbarians, samurai only with samurai

bools.name: dgqInterrelatedSameBirthRank
bools.comment: Interrelated prose (capture pp. 62-64): the interrelated characters share the birth rank and the Head of Family spaces

bools.name: dgqInterrelatedTwinsOnly
bools.comment: Interrelated prose (capture pp. 62-64): the same chart slot only for twins - and one must be older

bools.name: dgqInterrelatedSharedAncestry
bools.comment: Interrelated prose (capture pp. 62-64): one Ancestry roll set for both, the holdings and names identical

bools.name: dgqPcReentryFirstLevel
bools.comment: Deaths prose (capture pp. 62-64): a dead player character re-enters as a brother or sister, no property, normal birthright rolls, at 1st level

bools.name: dgqHeadTitleSuccession
bools.comment: Deaths prose (capture pp. 62-64): the head title passes to the next brother, else the eldest son

the death read - once per game year, the 75 percent firstborn pass (capture pp. 62-64)
the marriage read - 1-5 on 1d6 with the +10 bonus (capture pp. 62-64)
the adoption read - the 5 percent entry, the 1-2 orphan check, the +10 bonus (capture pp. 62-64)
table_checks.expr: m['dgqAdoptChancePct']() != 5 or m['dgqAdoptDiceSides']() != 6 or m['dgqAdoptOrphanMax']() != 2 or m['dgqAdoptBonusPct']() != 10
